card.name: Just before HIV or AIDS appears
card.fires_on: The spot right before the word HIV or AIDS is expected, often the first letter of HIV or AIDS, a parenthesis, or a linking word like 'and' or 'of'. Seen in drug labels about HIV and in web text about the AIDS epidemic.

modes.label: Inside the letters
modes.description: The first letter of HIV or AIDS when the name is split into pieces.

modes.label: Coinfection wording
modes.description: A split-up HCV/HIV-1 coinfection or a viral-load phrase, at the H of HIV.
